description: This file defines the 'FeatureCreated' event class within the 'org.eclipse.ditto.signals.events.things' package, representing an event emitted after a 'Feature' is created in the context of Eclipse Ditto. It includes constructors, JSON serialization/deserialization, and accessors for the feature details.
